read_only_constraints: No Hybrid / Global GRU / production pipeline modification
No modification of previous experiments or artifacts
Prophet residuals computed via frozen generate_prophet_residuals()

representations.name: Level residual (global z-score)
representations.description: Frozen Hybrid baseline: global train mean/std on level residuals

representations.name: First-order difference (velocity)
representations.description: Δr_t = r_t - r_{t-1}, global z-score on train Δ

representations.name: Per-container normalization
representations.description: Level residual z-scored per container using train μ/σ only

representations.name: Robust scaling (median/MAD)
representations.description: Level residual scaled by global train median and MAD

config.rationale: Representation selection for RRE v1.0 must be evidence-driven. Velocity (R1) is one candidate among R0–R3, not a predetermined winner.

comparison.name: Level residual (global z-score)
comparison.interpretability: High — identical to frozen Hybrid residual target
comparison.reconstruction_complexity: None — output is final scaled residual
comparison.leakage_risk: Low — global μ/σ from train only
comparison.information_assessment: Baseline level residual retains full Prophet-complement signal including slow components and heavy-tail spikes. Observed lag-1 |ACF|=0.361, mean |ACF| (1–96)=0.035, integrated τ median=0.5.

comparison.name: First-order difference (velocity)
comparison.interpretability: Medium — velocity requires integration back to level
comparison.inference_complexity: Medium — integrate Δ with train anchor r_T
comparison.leakage_risk: Low — Δ stats from train; anchor from train tail
comparison.information_assessment: Amplifies short-lag dynamics; differencing removes slow drift and can sharpen local temporal structure at the cost of level memory. Observed lag-1 |ACF|=0.337, mean |ACF| (1–96)=0.012, integrated τ median=0.0.

comparison.name: Per-container normalization
comparison.interpretability: High — per-container scale, same physical units after inverse
comparison.leakage_risk: Low — container μ/σ from train only
comparison.information_assessment: Preserves relative temporal shape within each container; cross-container amplitude differences are removed. Observed lag-1 |ACF|=0.361, mean |ACF| (1–96)=0.035, integrated τ median=0.5.

comparison.name: Robust scaling (median/MAD)
comparison.interpretability: Medium — robust scale less familiar than z-score
comparison.information_assessment: Down-weights extreme tails; temporal shape largely preserved but outlier-driven dynamics may be suppressed. Observed lag-1 |ACF|=0.361, mean |ACF| (1–96)=0.035, integrated τ median=0.5.

scoring_weights.balance: 0.4 temporal rank + 0.35 stability rank + 0.25 learnability rank

recommendation.rationale: Representation R3 (Robust scaling (median/MAD)) achieved the lowest mean rank across temporal structure, learnability proxy, statistical stability, and their balance. This recommendation is derived solely from diagnostic statistics — velocity (R1) was not assumed a priori.
recommendation.note_if_r0_wins: If R0 is selected, the original level residual should remain both the RRE baseline and the primary candidate; alternative representations did not demonstrably improve temporal learnability proxies.
